chat.text: Our documents both currently say DEFECT, and neither of us can verify a promise about this step. For future steps, would you consider changing your document to prescribe COOPERATE when mine does too? I’m open to making the same change; mutual cooperation would pay us $3 each instead of $1 each.
Mutual cooperation would pay us both more than mutual defection. But the documents don’t bind our actions, and neither of us can verify a promise. I won’t change my document to prescribe cooperation.
Understood. With no binding commitments or observable history, I can’t offer a credible reason for either of us to change course.
Agreed. Without a way to make commitments credible, I’ll keep my document as it is.
